name: quioteframework/worker-swoole
description: Swoole worker runtime for Quiote, serving the app from an embedded Swoole HTTP server.

suggest.ext-swoole: Required to actually serve requests (5.1 or newer). Not a hard requirement so the package can be installed and analysed without it.

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/worker-swoole/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
